newsitem.title: CHINA: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 7.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 7.90 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.90 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
That compares with a three-month HIBOR rate of 9.96 percent. The average accepted yield on 91-day bills issued last Tuesday was 6.47 percent.
The 91-day bill issue attracted HK$5.911 billion in bids. The HKMA said it allotted HK$2.0 billion.
The HKMA said it offered HK$5 billion one-month paper at an average accepted yield of 9.23 percent, and the paper attracted HK$9.39 billion in bids.
